row: Hey guys! My name is Spencer Boaz and I am a second year veterinary student at Kansas State.  I'm making this channel to give you guys an inside look at what its like to be a vet student and am hoping to help answer any questions you guys may have along the way.  Subscribe to stick around for all the fun and feel free to comment on any video if you have any questions about vet life and I will try to answer them! Hope to see you all soon!
